answer.answer:
September 21, 2024 — You focused on securing your Soneva Jani stay: six nights for $10,800 in an overwater villa, described as 1,200 sq ft. You verified that the $5,400 deposit had cleared, but said the resort-confirmation process was only 90% complete and wanted the final email.
September 21, 2024 — You declined the $200 resort-credit option and reviewed your spending, including plans to exchange $700 into Maldivian Rufiyaa with a 1.5% fee. Budget control remained a recurring concern throughout preparation.
September 22, 2024 — You checked the $1,000 round-trip Trans Maldivian Airways fare for two and kept the 9 AM departure your spouse preferred rather than switching to noon. You received an airline response within two hours and retained a speedboat fallback.
September 23, 2024 — You said your $450 Allianz insurance was fully in place. You reviewed coverage and claims procedures, including the $50,000 medical certificate and $25,000 evacuation coverage, reported no policy discrepancies, and rated Allianz support 5/5. You also worked on having transfer vouchers ready for the planned 7:30 AM seaplane check-in.
September 24, 2024 — You refined the itinerary around relaxation, snorkeling, spa time, private dining, picnics, and island exploration. You explicitly included a weather-delay buffer day, explored moving snorkeling from day 3 to day 4, and considered a shorter 10-day contingency version of the broader 15-day schedule.
September 24, 2024 — Your spouse rated the itinerary 10/10. You sought guidance on concierge review and emergency sharing with loved ones, requested three printed copies, and had bought a $15 Walmart travel journal to document the honeymoon.
September 25, 2024 — Packing became the main practical task: you set a 48-hour completion goal and later referred to a 36-hour reminder, sought your spouse’s input on formal shirts, and added a sixth evening outfit to your list. You had obtained lightweight Teva flip-flops and worked around the stated 20 kg seaplane luggage limit. Your later message clarified that clothing and swimsuits still needed packing, so the earlier progress ratings do not establish completion.
September 25, 2024 — You decided against renting a car and planned airport Uber transport at about $40 each way. You also worked on handing your lecture notes over to a colleague so university responsibilities would be covered.
September 26, 2024 — You chose to pursue hepatitis A vaccination and discussed joint pre-trip checks at City Health Clinic, budgeting about $150 and considering Apple Pay. Appointment details remained unresolved: you mentioned a 10 AM slot, later an 11 AM rescheduling, but also said you had never actually booked health appointments. The record therefore does not confirm completed checks or vaccinations.
September 27–28, 2024 — You worked on home and work arrangements, including utility auto-pay through Wells Fargo, university email responses, and a home-care checklist for your mom. You also practiced Dhivehi phrases and reviewed cultural norms. For emotional preparation, you chose to try Calm’s free content, discussed journaling and backup support from Melissa, and planned to limit news checks to five minutes daily.
September 29–30, 2024 — You reported reconfirming all major bookings without problems, while still seeking written confirmation of the resort’s 2 PM check-in. You reaffirmed the 9 AM transfer because it suited your routine and avoided potential afternoon delays, decided to carry an extra $50 USD for emergencies, checked your university autoresponder, and described yourselves as 100% prepared by September 30.
October 1, 2024 — Your messages shifted to arrival at Soneva Jani and your first seaplane experience. You discussed check-in assistance from Aisha and using the 24-hour concierge to manage jet lag and arrange activities without doing all the coordination yourselves.
October 2, 2024 — You planned a 6 AM villa-deck sunrise photo shoot suggested by your spouse, intended to ask Nimal about a customized honeymoon itinerary, spa treatments, and special dining, and sought confirmation of a 9 AM snorkeling pickup from the jetty.
October 3, 2024 — You continued adjusting the stay around a shared balance of yoga, snorkeling, good dinners, massages, and downtime. You explored stargazing and a night cruise and checked mild/no-spice dining options at Crab Shack. These were still planning discussions rather than proof of completed reservations; your final message that day specifically said you had not booked dinner reservations.
